name: loader-cue
title: Cue loader
description: The interface’s sounds as waveforms: a tap, a toggle, a bell and a success, each struck and written out by the accent head, then wiped away as the next one rings. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-phosphor
title: Phosphor loader
description: A scope’s beam sweeps a modulated signal across its graticule, each trace glowing where it was just written and fading behind the beam, the last sweeps lingering as ghosts. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-sustain
title: Sustain loader
description: A waterfall of spectra in perspective: each new spectrum rises at the front and flows back into the distance, so a struck note leaves a ridge that rings on, dying away, as the stack recedes. name: loader-isobar
title: Isobar loader
description: An isometric spectrum: lit columns on a plinth jump as notes are struck and fall back, each with a cap that holds its peak a moment before it drops, the last strike’s cap in the accent. name: loader-tempo
title: Tempo loader
description: A dial scaled in the motion tokens: the needle steps up through instant, fast, base, slow and deliberate, landing on each tick as it lights, then sweeps home. name: loader-locus
title: Locus loader
description: A Lissajous figure in three dimensions, three tones in one closed curve over its shadow on a construction frame, turning in perspective while the accent traces it with a bright wake. name: loader-vitals

description: A monitor’s sweep writes a steady pulse, each beat a double tap stepping up like a toggle clicking in, the accent head throbbing on the beat as the old trace clears ahead of it. name: loader-harmonics

description: A square built from sines: a chain of turning circles adds the odd harmonics one by one, and the wave its tip draws squares up, with every corner, then softens back to a sine. name: loader-delta
title: Delta loader
description: A line chart rewritten in place: a caret sweeps across it and each point it passes moves to its new value, leaving the old line as a dashed ghost and the change marked, three times a loop. title: Least squares loader
description: Scattered square particles gather into a trend, and a line in the accent finds it: it turns from level to the fit as the residuals between it and each point shrink, then the points scatter again. name: loader-bell
title: Bell loader
description: Square particles drop through a board of pegs, falling left or right at each, and stack in the bins below into a bell, which a curve then traces before the bins empty and it begins again. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-spool
title: Spool loader
description: A recorder’s drum turns in perspective while the accent stylus writes a trace onto it, the line winding round and rising a step each turn, so the record spools up the drum and fades at the top. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-wick
title: Wick loader
description: A live candlestick chart: the newest candle forms as its price wanders, wicks stretching to each extreme, then it closes, the chart steps left and the next one opens where it closed. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-caustic
title: Caustic loader
description: A cylindrical bundle of rays passes through a convex lens and converges at a travelling focus. Short light fronts cross the lens, meet at the waist and spread onto the receiving screen as the focus draws near and recedes. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-umbra
title: Umbra loader
description: An opaque disc drifts across an extended light source. Grazing rays bound its core shadow and soft penumbra on a gridded screen; a short light front travels along the clear boundary while the shadow follows the disc at its projected magnification. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-flux
title: Flux loader
description: A cage of field lines connects two opposed pole pieces. As the poles separate, the returning arches expand in six depth planes; short travelling strokes follow the field while one near arc briefly takes the accent. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-fringe
title: Fringe loader
description: A coherent beam meets two narrow slits. Paired circular wavefronts spread through depth, overlap, and reach a receiving screen whose bright and dark bands follow their path-length difference; the central fringe carries a small accent tick. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-capillary
title: Capillary loader
description: Three narrow tubes wet from a shared shallow bath. Their concave fronts climb to progressively greater heights as the bore narrows, pause at equilibrium, and retreat; fine level guides and the nearest wet rim follow each rise. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-refract
title: Refract loader
description: A sheet of parallel light crosses both inclined walls of a triangular prism. Its direction changes at each interface according to the same refractive ratio; travelling fronts narrow inside the glass and emerge onto a ruled receiving plane. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-azimuth
title: Azimuth loader
description: Three surveyed landmarks turn their bearings toward a common fix on a tilted map. Their uncertainty wedges narrow in sequence, the intersecting rays resolve a small coordinate cross, and the bearings release for the next observation. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-apsis
title: Apsis loader
description: A small faceted satellite accelerates around an elliptical orbit and slows at its far apsis. Three equal-time swept sectors reveal equal areas around the focus, while a companion circles the moving body in an inclined plane. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-nodal
title: Nodal loader
description: A circular membrane exchanges two standing-wave modes inside a fixed drum rim. Opposing lobes rise and fall around quiet nodal diameters, the wire skin follows the deformation, and a small rim exciter marks the exchange of energy. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-analyzer
title: Analyzer loader
description: A polarized wave crosses a fixed grid and a turning analyzer. Its transmitted oscillation follows the projection onto the moving axis, extinguishing at crossed alignment; the receiving screen brightens with the squared projection before the axes align again. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-descent
title: Descent loader
description: A measured descent follows the gradient of an asymmetric loss basin. Each iterate leaves a checkpoint, a tangent frame tilts to the local slope, and the next step shortens toward the minimum; the path retraces its evaluations to begin again. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-quantile
title: Quantile loader
description: A cumulative distribution is integrated from unequal sample intervals. Three probability readers travel to the curve and drop their value fences; four unequal-width strips then seat below it, each enclosing the same data mass, before the readers retrace. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-leader
title: Leader loader
description: A stepped discharge tests several paths between two electrodes. A rising streamer meets the descending leader, a restrained return stroke runs back up the connected channel, and the unsuccessful side branches drain away before the gap clears. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-overturn
title: Overturn loader
description: Two counterrotating convection cells lift a central plume from a heated bed. Layered streamlines fan out beneath the upper boundary and descend along the outer walls; short travelling strokes show the circulation while one accent front rises through the shared updraft. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-barcode
title: Barcode loader
description: A filtered complex connects its perimeter, adds radial edges, and fills its triangular faces. Every enclosed cycle writes its computed lifetime to a barcode below; long and short holes close at different stages, then the filtration unwrites back to isolated sites. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-blossom
title: Blossom loader
description: Three successive interpolation levels evaluate a spatial cubic curve. Sliding construction bars converge on its writing point, a tangent follows the generated stroke, and the evaluation retraces to release the curve without a reset. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.
